camel_example: aliyun polardb DescribeAIDBClusters --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key testKey --PageSize 30 --DBClusterIds 'pc-000000000000000' --PageNumber 1 --DBClusterStatus Running --AiNodeType 'vnode,container' --Tag.1.Value testValueData --DBClusterDescription 'pc-0000000000000000' --PayType Prepaid --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries the list of custom AI clusters
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-aidb-clusters --db-cluster-ids pc-000000000000000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --db-cluster-description pc-0000000000000000 --db-cluster-status Running --pay-type Prepaid --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ai-node-type vnode,container --tag Value=testValueData Key=testKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAIDBClusters

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Separate multiple cluster IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。多个集群ID间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.
                              
Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值为30、50或100。
                              
默认值为30。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The cluster description. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The cluster status. Valid values:

Creating: being created.
Running: running.
Deleting: being released.
Rebooting: being restarted.
DBNodeCreating: a node is being added (increase).
DBNodeDeleting: a node is being deleted.
ClassChanging: node specifications are being changed.
NetAddressCreating: a network connectivity is being created.
NetAddressDeleting: a network connectivity is being deleted.
NetAddressModifying: a network connectivity is being modified. 
Deleted: released.
ClassChanged: resources are being revoked after a decrease the quota operation
parameters.help_zh:
集群状态，取值范围如下：

Creating：创建中
Running：运行中
Deleting：释放中
Rebooting：重启中
DBNodeCreating：正在增加节点
DBNodeDeleting：正在删除节点
ClassChanging：正在变更节点规格
NetAddressCreating：正在创建网络连接
NetAddressDeleting：正在删除网络连接
NetAddressModifying：正在修改网络连接 
Deleted：已释放
ClassChanged：升降配结束资源回收中
parameters.name: db_cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

Postpaid：按量付费
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Multiple types are supported. Separate two values with a comma (,).

vnode: managed by Kubernetes.
container: logon-enabled container.
maas: model service
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型。支持多个类型搜索，两个值用逗号隔离：

vnode： K8s纳管
container：可登录容器
maas: 模型服务
parameters.name: ai_node_type

fields.help_en: The tag key. You can filter the cluster list by tag. You can specify up to 20 tag pairs. The number n for each tag pair must be unique and must be a consecutive integer starting from 1. The value of Tag.n.Key corresponds to Tag.n.Value
fields.help_zh: 标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。Tag.n.Key对应的值为Tag.n.Value
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value that corresponds to the tag key
fields.name: value

DBCluster.description_en: The list of AI cluster instances

items.description_en: The properties of an AI cluster instance

AiNodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

vnode: managed by Kubernetes.
container: logon-enabled container.
maas: model service

节点类型。可选：

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created

DBType.description_en: The database engine type. Currently, only polardb_ai is supported
DBType.description_zh: 数据库引擎类型，当前仅支持polardb_ai类型

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time.
Only clusters with the Prepaid (subscription) billing method return a specific value. Postpaid (pay-as-you-go) clusters return an empty value
ExpireTime.description_zh:
到期时间。
仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true

false
Expired.description_zh:
是否集群已过期。取值范围如下：

true

false

LockMode.description_en:
The lock status of the cluster. Valid values: 

Unlock: Normal. 
ManualLock: manually locked. 
LockByExpiration: automatically locked due to cluster expiration
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定状态，取值范围如下： 

Unlock：正常。 
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。 
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。取值范围： 

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月（预付费）。

RunType.description_en:
The run type. Valid values:
container: container.
default: node
RunType.description_zh:
运行类型。可选：
container： 容器
default：节点

StorageSpace.description_en: The storage space after the change. Unit: GB
StorageSpace.description_zh: 变更后的存储空间。单位：GB

essdpl0

essdpl3
